In the spring of 2022, my son and I (he’s 43) were in his back yard doing some clean up in mid-afternoon on a clear, sunny day. He was approx. twenty feet away from me working on something when I turned to see what he was doing and caught sight of a UAP moving across my field of vision from left to right. It was about 100 feet away from me and about 50 feet above me as it flew by … I said something to the effect of “What the (Removed Profanity-cah)?” at which time my son looked up at me then turned to see what I was looking at…it was very similar to the “Mosul Orb” in size and speed of movement, but it appeared to be a spinning box in a round force field (for lack of a better description)…we watched it until it was gone over the horizon and then we both went back to doing whatever it was we were doing. My normal reaction should have been me freaking out and talking about what we just saw in a loud, excited voice… for hours on end. We never spoke of it again…for two years.
